statement.text: Let $R_r(n)$ denote the $r$-uniform hypergraph Ramsey number: the minimal $m$ such that if we $2$-colour all edges of the complete $r$-uniform hypergraph on $m$ vertices then there must be some monochromatic copy of the complete $r$-uniform hypergraph on $n$ vertices. Prove that, for $r\geq 3$, $ \log_{r-1} R_r(n) \asymp_r n, $ where $\log_{r-1}$ denotes the $(r-1)$-fold iterated logarithm. That is, does $R_r(n)$ grow like $ 2^{2^{\cdots n}} $ where the tower of exponentials has height $r-1$?
